note: Prompts people actually type, per skill: positive ones should pick the skill first from the listing, negative ones should not. check.py runs scripts/triggers.py on them. A miss is fixed in the description, never by rewording the prompt. min_rank1 / max_negative_hits record a skill that doesn't pass yet (default: every positive, no negative); they only go up. similar_pairs lists description pairs allowed above max_similarity.
